title: Dynamic Theory: a machine-verified reconstruction (Lean 4/Mathlib proofs and assertion-driven SageMath scripts)
description: Verification corpus for the Dynamic Theory of Pharis E. Williams (LA-8370-MS, 1980). Two verification layers, Lean 4 / Mathlib / Physlib proofs and assertion-driven SageMath / SymPy scripts, organised in three layers that divide the Chapter-1 flow chart, with run logs and a per-layer index. The code behind the article "Recovery of the gravitational and particle sectors in Dynamic Theory" is the restricted companion repository Dynamic-Theory-GR-SM, generated from this one.
